elements.name: Student
responsibilities: requests a seat reservation through the REST endpoint

elements.name: ReservationController
responsibilities: exposes the REST endpoints for creating, cancelling and checking in reservations
turns request parameters into a ReservationRequestDTO
REST endpoints for creating, cancelling and checking in reservations

elements.name: LibraryFacade
responsibilities: single entry point of the application layer for the boundaries
delegates reservation operations to ReservationManager
facade delegating requests to the managers

elements.name: ReservationManager
responsibilities: validates room, area, seat and student for a booking
checks that the student has no overlapping reservation
picks a seat and saves the reservation
notifies observers after saving
validates and creates reservations, assigns seats

elements.name: StudyRoomRegistry
responsibilities: registry for study rooms, areas, seats and time slots
finds them through PersistenceManager
reads rooms, areas, seats and time slots through PersistenceManager

elements.name: Area
responsibilities: persisted area of a study room that groups seats
lists its available seats for a date and time slot
creates its seats
